_note: Layer B — the authored layer. Zone polygons below are TRANSCRIBED from the author's annotated Google Maps reference (pen colours: blue=water, grey=plain, yellow=trade, green=forest, red=settlement). They are OVERRIDES: they win over the OSM classifier inside their bounds. Where two overrides overlap, the higher `priority` wins; ties go to the later entry. Everything outside them is classified from OSM alone. Bounds are [south, west, north, east] and were projected from the reference image — verify each against OSM before shipping.
_deposits: Bonus resources are allocated PER AREA, never per hex. See ZONE / depositCount / allocate in worldseed.ts: contiguous same-terrain clusters are split into areas of 7–55 hexes, each area gets 1–3 deposits, and each deposit sits on ONE hex. Roughly 5% of hexes carry a deposit. A hex with `resources: []` is correct.

zoneOverrides.name: Pyhäjärvi
zoneOverrides.note: Everything north of this line is water. Deep-water flag beyond 250 m from shore.

zoneOverrides.name: Vähäjärven suo
zoneOverrides.note: The wet ring around Vähäjärvi. Overlaps the Vähäjärvenpuisto forest override and wins on priority — the park is forest at its edges and bog at its centre. Carries peat, bog iron and will-o'-wisps, and hosts the Sunken Bell wonder.

landmarks.name: Statue of the Boy
landmarks.lore: Raised for a child who went into the water and did not come out. The plaque gives no name, which is how you know one was removed.

landmarks.name: Villa Härmälänranta
landmarks.lore: A guest house that has burned twice and been rebuilt to the same plan both times.

landmarks.name: Härmälän kirkko
landmarks.lore: Concrete, 1950s, and the only building in the district whose foundations nobody will discuss.

landmarks.name: Härmälän veneenlaskupaikka
landmarks.lore: Boats go in here. The count going out has been wrong three times this decade.

landmarks.name: Härmälän Pumptrack
landmarks.lore: Dirt shaped into waves by teenagers. It happens to match a pattern on the observatory wall.

landmarks.name: Rantaperkiön tekonurmikenttä
landmarks.lore: Green that stays green through February. Nothing grows through it, which is the point.

anchorStone.note: The Keep. Player's first cell in the current build — kept where it is.

wonders.note: Deepest surveyed water in the bbox, 900 m off Härmälänsaari.
Härmälänsaari — the only island in range.
Shore Line × Island Reach crossing, on the Pereen rise.
Rantaperkiön metsä. Moved here when Vähäjärvenpuisto became marsh — this is the remaining old-growth forest in the bbox.
Vähäjärven suo — the only marsh area in the bbox, so the predicate resolves here uncontested.
Härmälänranta industrial edge, highest road density.
Must sit ON the Statue of the Boy landmark.
Highest relief in the bbox. ⚠ Härmälä is flat — confirm against a DEM or move this wonder out of the area.

questChains.name: What Sleeps at the Shore
questChains.note: Node coordinates transcribed from the author's third reference image: numerals 1–5 are nodes, X marks are item caches.

nodes.name: The Wet Footprints
nodes.task: Walk the shore path between the Keep and the villa. Three sets of prints leave the water and none return.

nodes.name: The Innkeeper's Ledger
nodes.task: Reach Villa Härmälänranta and read the guest book for the nights nobody signed out.

nodes.name: The Boy's Errand
nodes.task: Take the statue's request inland, to the block that was built over the old beach.

nodes.name: The Borrowed Boat
nodes.task: The slipway. Take what is already untied.

nodes.name: The Eye Opens
nodes.task: Cross to Härmälänsaari and stand where the island watches the shore. Unlocks the Eye of Pyhäjärvi wonder site.

items.name: Brass Diving-Bell Key
items.found: Buried at Härmälän uimaranta, two metres from the statue's shadow at noon.

items.name: Waterlogged Ledger Page
items.found: In the shallows east of the villa. Legible only while wet.

items.name: Coil of Tarred Rope
items.found: On the Pereen rise, under the observatory site. Still smells fresh.

expectedCounts._note: Assertions the seeder must satisfy or fail loudly. Guards against a silent Overpass timeout producing an all-plain world.
